problem.title: When a buyer asks for pricing, the product price isn't the hard part.
problem.intro: You probably run into these every week:
items: The buyer asks for CIF, DAP, or DDP — but you don't know how to price freight and destination charges.
You asked three forwarders — you can see whose ocean freight is cheaper, but not which option actually pencils out in the end.
You're not sure whether this product needs special documents for the US, Europe, or Japan.
You don't know if destination duties, clearance fees, and document requirements will eat the margin.
Every inquiry means re-assembling product data, dimensions, packing details, HS codes, MSDS, invoices, packing lists.
The buyer wants a quote now — but you're still waiting on the forwarder.
problem.punchLead: So the inquiry sits there, and the one question you can't answer fast is:
problem.punchEmph: Can we actually take this order?

whyUs.title: Not another system. An export operations partner.
whyUs.body: We don't ask you to change how you work, and we don't replace your forwarder or customs broker. We clean up the messiest, most time-consuming front end of every overseas inquiry — so you, your forwarders, your broker, and your buyer align faster.

finalCta.body: Send us the inquiry, the product data, and the destination. We'll turn it into an export plan you can use to reply to the customer, compare logistics options, check the margin, and arrange the shipment.

items.a: We're not a traditional forwarder, and we don't replace yours. We're the export operations layer: we organize your overseas inquiries, freight quotes, document requirements, and landed cost. The actual carriage, transport, and customs filing are executed by partner forwarders, brokers, or the partners you already work with.

items.q: I already have a forwarder. Do I still need you?
items.a: Yes — keep your forwarder. We clean up the inquiry data, compare quotes across forwarders, and check for document gaps, so you know exactly what each quote includes, what it leaves out, and which option fits this shipment.

items.q: Can you guarantee HS codes or duty rates are correct?
items.a: No. We provide preliminary analysis, risk mapping, and a list of questions that need confirming. Final classification, duty rates, and the formal customs filing should always be confirmed by a customs broker, licensed broker, or the relevant professional.

items.q: Can I submit an incomplete inquiry?
items.a: Yes. Most overseas inquiries start incomplete. We'll map out what's missing — dimensions and weight, materials, use case, MSDS, catalogs, delivery address, or Incoterms.

items.q: Does this work for small shipments?
items.a: Yes. For small sample runs, air freight, courier, LCL, or a first-ever export, we'll help you find the right logistics mode and document requirements.

Start with a one-off Export Desk Pilot. If you have a steady flow of overseas inquiries or shipments, a monthly plan is available — we keep handling your export inquiries, quote comparisons, landed costs, and shipment coordination.
